title: How I made $14,000 during Alpha
author: Glassape
selftext:
Hey everyone, little background about me. I am a glass artist, and I build agentic workflows for law firms for my main income. I made a glassblowing simulator in my free time and decided to open a small alpha for people to play. I posted it on my instagram @mortonglassworks and it went viral with 650k views. It’s the first of its kind so I believe it helped my exposure.

I hosted it on vercel, had no domain purchased yet, just an idea. In the first 24 hours, i have over 10,000 visitors. After noticing a huge influx of attention, I decided that I needed to start monetizing and scaling my databases.

I started selling Ad Sponsorships on my game for $50-200 a month depending on location.

In 1 week, I received $14,000 in sponsorships from Artists, collectors, museums, color companies, tool companies. I paid $0 for marketing, it just happened to be a missing piece to the industry. 

Now how did this work? At first I was scared to ask for $50 a month, but within 1 day i raised different areas from $50-200 and people still were not flinching. I create their logo in game, and people can click and interact inside of the game. Lots of people have never been inside a game, so incorporating them was a new experience for them to be apart of. Everyone wants to be inside of a game, and you can make this happen.

Im now in talks with a company who wants to invest in the production, they already gave sponsorship money prior. You never know who is ready until you throw yourself out there.

Our first competition worth $2,200 for players ends today. I am now working on setting up a steam and itch pages.

I would say find a niche you care about and are knowledgable about, for example you’re an electrician make a game involving that skill that you have the upper hand in. Its hard to translate a vision between developers

Happy to help anyone with any questions of how this worked, and their approach. I am by no means an expert, just sharing my experience so others can learn.

If i could go back id change a bunch of things.

comments.author: alcarcalimo1950
comments.body: Cool that worked for you. I don’t think we should be promoting “get rich from AI generated games”. We have to stop treating this like it’s easy or simple. Making a good game is not an easy process, and can still cost a lot of many considering the token spend.

replies.author: Glassape
replies.body:
i never said it was easy, ive spent hundreds of hours on it, made 6 games prior. If you think get rich is $14k id love to live in your reality haha

Im legitimately releasing it, getting real investors from it

replies.author: alcarcalimo1950
replies.body: Yes, but your post reads like that regardless of what you feel about it. I’m not doubting what you say happened. I just think promoting it to people is not good. It’s not going to be the experience for most people at the alpha stage, even if you make a good one.
